description: Build a personal link-in-bio page and download it as a standalone HTML file.

faqs.a: Add your name, bio and links one by one, pick a theme, then click Download HTML — you get a single self-contained file you can host anywhere.
Yes — the download is one HTML file with inline styles; no external dependencies.
Upload it to any static host (GitHub Pages, Netlify, Vercel) or use it as your bio link directly.
Links open in a new tab by default (target=_blank with rel=noopener).
faqs.q: Do links open in a new tab?

howto: Enter your name, tagline and bio.
Add links with labels and URLs.
Pick a theme and see the live preview.
Click Download HTML to get your page.
title: Link in Bio Maker
